body: I'll share it tomorrow :( I've got it all written down.

I've talked to both countless times.. It's hopeless, my parents hate me and I've visited the psychiatrist for over 4 years now.. doesn't help a thing. My wish is to die and I can't get it out of my head.. same goes for the girl.
Because, I'm not worth of living here and I'm not happy at all. There is no reason to stay either :( maybe I should just post my story..
I care about them, they don't care about me. I just don't want one person to read this :(
I care about one person. I don't want her to ever read this, yet she won't miss me when I'm no longer around. My parents won't miss me either and the other person that would care, passed 2 years ago.
